theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_fc_tsum_count_arith
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) (θ : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 < t → (∀ i, w i ≤ t) → ∑' i, (θ i : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (w i) = ENNReal.ofReal ((m : ℝ) * t) → (m : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ∑' i, (θ i : ℝ≥0∞) ∧ ∀ (i₀ : ι) (k : ℕ), (∀ i, 1 ≤ θ i) → θ i₀ = k → w i₀ = t → (∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → w i < t) → k ≤ m ∧ (k < m → (m : ℝ≥0∞) + 1 ≤ ∑' i, (θ i : ℝ≥0∞))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
